```{r}
#| label: install.library

library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse) # dplyr and ggplot2
library(mapview)
library(censusapi)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(sf)

fairfax_pop_2020 = get_decennial(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "P1_001N", # TOTAL POPULATION
  state = "VA",
  county = "Fairfax County", 
  sumfile = "pl", 
  year = 2020, 
  geometry = TRUE, # Toggle T/F for shapefiles
  show_call = TRUE)

sum(fairfax_pop_2020$value) # 1150309

ggplot(fairfax_pop_2020, aes(fill = value, color = value)) + 
  geom_sf() # + facet_wrap(~ variable)

```

- VDOE CSV - Fall 2526 Enrollment

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| output: false

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
fall_enr = read_csv("data/fall_membership_statistics.csv") |> as_tibble() |> 
  clean_names()

```

- VDOE List of schools & addresses, cleaned

```{r}
#| eval: true 
#| echo: false 
#| output: false

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
fcps_all_schools <- read_csv("data/fcps_all_schools.csv") |> as_tibble() |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(full_address = str_replace_all(full_address, "\n", " ")) |> 
  mutate(full_address = str_trim(full_address)) |> 
  mutate(sch_name = str_remove_all(name, "\n")) |> 
  select(-c(og_cell, name)) |> 
  select(sch_name, level, cat, phone, full_address) |> 
  rename(grades = level, sch_cat = cat)

# And merged

dataset = left_join(fcps_all_schools, fall_enr, by = c("sch_name" = "school_name")) |> 
  rename(sch_id = school_number, year = school_year) |> 
  select(-c(division_number, division_name)) 

```
